purpose: Define one collaborative preconstruction strategy that treats every pinned D01-D12 deficiency without redefining any deficiency or granting product-construction authority.

workstreams.name: SEAMLESS_VISIBLE_WORLD_CONTINUATION
workstreams.objective: Make the authored region and noninteractive continuation read as one continuous world while preserving the frozen accessible extent.
actions: Sample the authored edge continuously for elevation, slope, terrain frequency, shoreline direction, water level and atmospheric state.
Create a middle-distance transition band that inherits those edge conditions before progressively reducing detail, contrast and geometric frequency.
Use asymmetrical distant silhouettes and atmosphere rather than a uniform enclosing wall, shelf or rectangular perimeter.
Keep the ocean-facing continuation open water plus atmospheric depth where geography requires it; never generate opposing land across the continental-edge ocean view.
Keep all exterior continuation nonaddressable, noncollidable and nonnavigable.
Prohibit any further playable-terrain enlargement as a seam-hiding mechanism.
successEvidence: No perimeter, shelf, wall, rectangular horizon cue, abrupt tonal break or elevation break is perceptible from representative traversal positions.
Visible-world extent exceeds accessible extent while accessible addresses, collision and navigation topology remain unchanged.

workstreams.name: SUBTROPICAL_CAUSAL_ENVIRONMENT
workstreams.objective: Make Gratitude read immediately as a warm subtropical coastal environment through causal ecological relationships rather than palette replacement.
actions: Drive moisture, vegetation and material response from local elevation, slope, drainage, freshwater proximity, coastal exposure, shelter and aspect fields.
Increase vegetation and humid material response in valleys, drainage corridors, sheltered lower slopes and freshwater-influenced areas.
Retain exposed soil and geology on steep, wind-exposed, rocky or otherwise causally justified surfaces.
Treat the shore as an ecological gradient from inland vegetation through coastal scrub/grass, dry beach, wet beach, nearshore water and humid atmosphere.
Introduce atmospheric humidity and distance haze consistent with a warm subtropical coast without flattening visibility or terrain readability.
Require first-glance environmental identity to work without explanatory text.
successEvidence: Independent first-glance review no longer classifies the environment as desert/arid.
Vegetation and material distribution can be explained by the causal fields rather than uniform placement.
The coast reads as a living transition rather than a geometric seam between tan land and blue water.

workstreams.name: MORPHOLOGY_TOLERANT_ENVIRONMENTAL_ARCHITECTURE
workstreams.objective: Ensure the environmental system survives later Gratitude coastline and macro-shape correction without redesign.
actions: Keep biome and material rules dependent on local physical fields, not distance from the current outer perimeter.
Separate macro coastline masks from reusable local climate, hydrology and ecology evaluation.
Require remapping rather than redesign when coastline or region perimeter changes.
Structure the causal rules so later H-Earth regions can reuse them only after Gratitude proves them believable.
successEvidence: A hypothetical coastline remap does not require rewriting the climate/biome rule set.
No primary environmental driver is keyed to the provisional blob perimeter.

workstreams.name: GRATITUDE_POSITIONAL_STANDARD_DISCOVERY
workstreams.objective: Develop a believable regional morphology before using Gratitude to constrain Audralia continental composition.
actions: Keep the current macro silhouette explicitly provisional during environmental repair.
Use proven local relief, drainage direction, headlands, bays, peninsulas, coastal openings and watershed-to-coast relationships to discover directional macro form.
Reject radial or blob-like symmetry where it is not supported by those regional causes.
Do not force regional geometry to match the current globe merely for visual agreement.
Do not promote regional geometry back to planetary authority until the regional environment passes geographic and environmental believability thresholds.
After regional pass, reconcile Gratitude's proven positional relationships back to Audralia and use them as a calibration constraint for surrounding continental composition.
successEvidence: The regional morphology exhibits causally legible directional asymmetry rather than a generic rounded mass.
A later globe reconciliation can cite proven regional relationships rather than copying a local mesh silhouette literally.

workstreams.name: RECIPROCAL_ENVIRONMENTAL_IDENTITY
workstreams.objective: Make environmental identity a first-class reciprocal comparison dimension alongside geography.
actions: Compare climate regime, biome family, hydrologic expression, vegetation distribution, atmosphere and material palette between H-Earth and Audralia at scale-appropriate resolution.
Preserve the rule that same canonical identity does not require identical visual resolution or smoothing.
Record any regional discovery that requires globe reconciliation rather than silently changing either side.
Prevent the current planetary blob from prejudicing regional development and prevent provisional regional detail from prejudicing planetary composition.
successEvidence: Regional and planetary representations can be described as the same place in both geography and environmental identity without literal mesh equivalence.
Any remaining mismatch is explicitly classified as a reconciliation obligation rather than ignored.

workstreams.name: REFERENCE_CLASS_EXPERIENCE_AND_DEVICE_QUALIFICATION
workstreams.objective: Require the repaired environment to meet cross-device, accessibility, performance, interaction and perceptual excellence thresholds on the exact candidate.
actions: Qualify phone, tablet and desktop initial, traversal and representative result states on the exact candidate SHA.
Verify navigation, input continuity, collision boundaries and return behavior are unchanged unless separately authorized.
Measure and inspect frame stability, loading behavior and interaction responsiveness sufficient to ensure the environmental improvements do not destroy usability.
Check accessibility obligations applicable to the entered-world interface and controls.
Perform reference-class first-glance and sustained-immersion adjudication after technical checks.
Fail if any defect is merely hidden by crop, camera angle, fog, or reduced draw distance instead of resolved.
successEvidence: Exact-candidate phone/tablet/desktop evidence exists for required states.
No protected interaction or navigation regression is observed.
The implementation mechanism is no longer a dominant perceptual read.

interactionLaws: D03 must not be treated by uniform greening; D04 and D05 causal relationships must be solved with it.
D01 must not be treated by another region expansion; D02 continuity and D07 architectural separation must constrain it.
D06 must not be frozen before D03-D05 establish a believable place and D07 keeps those systems morphology-tolerant.
D08 reciprocity must remain bidirectional: neither current globe nor current region is allowed to become authority merely by being more developed.
D09 reference-class quality is a cross-cutting result of resolved geography, ecology, immersion, interaction and execution, not a cosmetic finishing pass.
D12 reuse is proven only after Gratitude works; premature generalization is prohibited.

nextBoundary.law: THE STRATEGY MAY DEFINE HOW DEFICIENCIES COOPERATE, BUT PRODUCT SOURCE MAY NOT CHANGE UNTIL A SEPARATE CONSTRUCTION OPERATION IS ADMITTED AGAINST THIS EXACT STRATEGY.
